comment: Structured creative log for the Rep Today social PMF test kit (05-social-pmf). One record per pre-registered angle. Schema mirrors 09-extras/marketing-agent/angles.seed.json (angle_id, pain_rank, pain_state, verbatim_quote, pain_source_url, hypothesis, hook, format, platform, preregistered_success_signal, kill_criterion) plus status and results so the two systems interoperate. Every pain traces to 01-research/pain-point-frequency.md or, where pain_rank is null, to flagged supply-side evidence in 01-research/meta-ad-library-sweep.md. All sources fetched 2026-08-01. No results exist because nothing has ever been published; results stay null until a real read happens. Platform names the primary adjudicating platform; every asset mirrors to the other test platform per platform-assignment.md. The seed file's instagram assignments are superseded by the v2 platform research.

angles.pain_state: Decision fatigue before a workout; excessive scrolling and clicks before anything starts.
angles.verbatim_quote: I need the app to tell me exactly what to do
angles.hypothesis: People with decision fatigue hold on a demo where the session already exists at app open, without any narration.
angles.hook: Most workout apps open with a question. This one opens with the workout.
angles.format: 8-12s screen record, cold open to ready session, no cuts, real time
angles.ab_pair: AB-1 (leg A; leg B hook: 'Open the app. The workout is already there.')
angles.preregistered_success_signal: watched-full rate in top half of bank rank with >=200 impressions
angles.kill_criterion: bottom quartile watched-full on two consecutive weekly reads

angles.pain_state: Losing a streak through no fault of your own resets you to zero and makes people quit entirely.
angles.verbatim_quote: That was it, back to 0, through no fault of my own.
angles.hypothesis: A first-person founder story about being celebrated after missing days outperforms mechanic-only framing of forgiveness.
angles.hook: I skipped four days and my app celebrated my comeback. On purpose. I built it that way.
angles.format: 20-30s founder-on-camera with screen-record insert of the return flow
angles.preregistered_success_signal: comments referencing streaks/forgiveness plus top-half watched-full rank
angles.kill_criterion: zero on-topic comments and bottom-half watch-through after two reads

angles.pain_state: Streak mechanics punish a missed day so hard that losing the streak comes as a relief.
angles.verbatim_quote: Then after 200 days, I lost my streak and... breathed a sigh of relief.
angles.hypothesis: The forgiveness mechanic shown silently (score dips, never resets) is believed and held on without a human presenter.
angles.hook: Miss a day and your score dips. It never resets.
angles.format: 12s screen record, missed day then dipped-not-zeroed score
angles.ab_pair: AB-2 (leg A; leg B hook: 'Missing a day never zeroes you out.')
angles.preregistered_success_signal: viewed-vs-swiped rate in top half of bank rank
angles.kill_criterion: bottom quartile viewed rate on two consecutive weekly reads

angles.pain_state: Prescribed sessions do not fit the time you actually have.
angles.verbatim_quote: trying to finish up in 30-40 minutes what the app would have you take 60 minutes to do
angles.hypothesis: People squeezed by fixed long prescriptions respond to a 5-minute session presented as a full show-up, not a consolation.
angles.hook: This whole workout is five minutes. It counts as showing up.
angles.format: 15-20s labeled timelapse of one real 5-minute session with app screen bookends
angles.ab_pair: AB-5 (leg A; leg B hook: 'Five minutes on a hotel-room floor still counts.'; pair queued for window 2)
angles.preregistered_success_signal: saves per 1,000 impressions in top half of bank rank
angles.kill_criterion: bottom quartile saves rate on two consecutive weekly reads

angles.pain_state: Home programs quietly demand large gym equipment you do not have.
angles.verbatim_quote: Sometimes they used large gym equipment not typical for a home
angles.hypothesis: Stating zero equipment as the whole identity (not a feature bullet) earns saves from small-space and traveling users.
angles.hook: A floor and a wall. That is the whole equipment list.
angles.format: 12s video, slow pan of a bare room then app opens to a ready session
angles.preregistered_success_signal: saves per 1,000 impressions top half plus comments naming travel or small space
angles.kill_criterion: bottom quartile saves on two consecutive weekly reads

angles.pain_state: Cloud load and sync failures block workouts and destroy progress.
angles.verbatim_quote: the app won't load or needs logged out/back in
angles.hypothesis: The under-100ms build is more credible shown perceptually (slow motion) than stated as a spec.
angles.hook: The workout is built before the screen finishes appearing.
angles.format: 15s high-frame-rate cold open in slow motion then real speed, no cuts within takes
angles.ab_pair: AB-4 (leg A; leg B hook: 'Generated on your phone, offline, in under 100 milliseconds.'; pair queued for window 2)
angles.preregistered_success_signal: average % viewed top half plus speed-related comments in either direction
angles.kill_criterion: bottom quartile % viewed and zero speed-related comments after two reads

angles.pain_state: Paywall or subscription gates everything; the app will not do anything until a trial that converts to paid.
angles.verbatim_quote: you cannot use this app unless you pay for it. You just can't.
angles.hypothesis: People burned by hard paywalls respond to a founder reading a real paywall review and answering it with an absolute free tier.
angles.hook: Founder reads the verbatim review aloud, then: So in mine, the workouts are free. All of them. Forever.
angles.format: 20s founder-on-camera, review shown as on-screen text while read
angles.ab_pair: AB-3 (leg A pain-first; leg B opens with 'Free means the workouts. All of them. Forever.')
angles.preregistered_success_signal: comments per 1,000 impressions top half plus comment sentiment echoing the paywall pain
angles.kill_criterion: bottom quartile comments rate on two consecutive weekly reads

angles.pain_state: SUPPLY-SIDE EVIDENCE, flagged: no complaint-side mined quote exists; pliability's ads sell desk-worker mobility resets, and no observed advertiser sells mobility as the workout itself for non-athletes.
angles.verbatim_quote: Your workflow is missing one thing. Short mobility resets built into your work-from-home routine
angles.hypothesis: Desk-bound users respond to mobility presented as a co-equal pillar of the session, not a warm-up or an athlete recovery tool.
angles.hook: Half your session can be the part other apps skip.
angles.format: 15s screen record scrolling a generated session with mobility blocks visibly co-equal
angles.preregistered_success_signal: saves per 1,000 impressions top half plus comments naming desk work or stiffness
angles.kill_criterion: bottom quartile saves on two consecutive weekly reads

angles.pain_state: Streak and badge machinery is the category consensus; builders already position against streak anxiety, and the mined quit stories show why.
angles.verbatim_quote: No streak anxiety. No guilt. No 'you failed today' energy.
angles.hypothesis: Arguing against the engagement-machinery consensus with our own mechanics only reads as contrarian and earns comment engagement.
angles.hook: I built a workout app with no streaks, on purpose. Watch what happens when I miss a day.
angles.format: 20-30s founder-on-camera intro then screen record of a missed day dipping without resetting
angles.ab_pair: AB-6 (leg A; leg B hook: 'Watch what happens in my app when I miss a day.')
angles.preregistered_success_signal: comments per 1,000 impressions top half plus comment sentiment engaging the no-streaks argument
angles.kill_criterion: bottom quartile comments rate on two consecutive weekly reads

angles.pain_state: Deciding is the taxing part; relying on a default removes the decision fatigue.
angles.verbatim_quote: if I rely on the default that I just go out for a run as soon as I wake up, the rest of the day just flows from that without the decision fatigue
angles.hypothesis: The essay-layer inversion (the app is the disciplined one) can survive 6-second compression when anchored by an immediate demo; positioning.md sanctions exactly one PMF test of this.
angles.hook: The most disciplined thing I own is a workout app. Watch.
angles.format: 15-20s founder-on-camera line then immediate cold-open demo, no chaperone sentence
angles.preregistered_success_signal: watched-full rate top half AND no drill-sergeant misreading in comment sentiment
angles.kill_criterion: any drill-sergeant misreading in comments, or bottom-half watch-through; either retires the inversion to essay-only permanently with no rerun

angles.pain_state: Internet requirement is a dealbreaker; connectivity failures destroy progress mid-trip.
angles.verbatim_quote: It doesn't need internet connection to fully operate (workouts)... So it stays offline (forever).
angles.hypothesis: Offline-first demanders respond to on-device generation proven with airplane mode visibly on.
angles.hook: Airplane mode on. The session still builds.
angles.format: 10-12s continuous screen record: airplane mode toggle, cold open, ready session
angles.preregistered_success_signal: comments naming offline as the reason plus top-half viewed rate
angles.kill_criterion: no offline-naming comments and below-median viewed rate after 14 days

angles.pain_state: Session length cannot be adjusted to the time you actually have.
angles.verbatim_quote: Now the part I want to be added on it to be able to adjust the time even after starting the practice.
angles.hypothesis: People whose windows change size respond to instant regeneration at a new duration more than to the initial readiness.
angles.hook: Got 20 minutes instead of 10? One tap.
angles.format: 10s screen record: duration chip 10 to 20, session rebuilt instantly, real time, no cuts
angles.kill_criterion: bottom quartile watched-full on two consecutive weekly reads

angles.pain_state: After losing a streak, people never come back to the app at all.
angles.verbatim_quote: I lost my streak somewhere in the middle of this enshittification process and I've never really gotten back to using the site
angles.hypothesis: The return-after-a-gap moment (easy session served, return celebrated) is the emotional peak of the forgiveness story and outperforms the score mechanic alone.
angles.hook: Come back after a week away and the app celebrates it.
angles.format: 15s screen record: history gap, easy session served, return acknowledgment
angles.preregistered_success_signal: viewed-vs-swiped rate top half plus comments telling their own quit story
angles.kill_criterion: bottom quartile viewed rate on two consecutive weekly reads

angles.pain_state: The app will not do anything until you enter a free trial that silently converts to paid.
angles.verbatim_quote: the app won't do anything until you sign up for the free trial (which, if you forget, will convert to paid)
angles.hypothesis: People wary of trial traps hold on a fresh-install demo reaching a first rep with zero forms and zero card prompts.
angles.hook: No login. No quiz. No trial that quietly converts to paid. Open, then start.
angles.format: 15-20s screen record: fresh install to first movement, real time, no cuts
angles.kill_criterion: bottom quartile watched-full on two consecutive weekly reads

angles.pain_state: Excessive scrolling and multiple clicks stand between opening an app and doing anything.
angles.verbatim_quote: excessive scrolling, multiple clicks to get to something
angles.hypothesis: Quantifying our own friction (one tap to first rep) lands harder than describing the absence of friction.
angles.hook: Taps between opening this app and your first rep: one.
angles.format: 10s screen record with a tap counter overlay that increments only on visible taps, real time
angles.preregistered_success_signal: watched-full rate top half plus saves per 1,000 impressions above bank median
angles.kill_criterion: bottom quartile watched-full on two consecutive weekly reads

angles.pain_state: A setup that removes decisions is praised precisely because it eliminates the decision fatigue of training.
angles.verbatim_quote: Overall I find this setup eliminates the decision fatigue of training
angles.hypothesis: A builder-audience explanation of why it opens instantly (the AI never generates a workout, a deterministic engine does) earns disproportionate comment quality even at low reach.
angles.hook: The AI in my workout app is not allowed to build workouts. That is why it opens instantly.
angles.format: 30-45s founder-on-camera with one diagram card; must include the at-launch AI disclosure in post or pinned comment
angles.preregistered_success_signal: comments per 1,000 impressions top half; substantive technical comments counted individually
angles.kill_criterion: bottom quartile comments rate on two consecutive weekly reads
